response.overview: A chance encounter at an oncology center, caused by mixed-up test results, intertwines the lives of Aidar and Dina. Deciding to spend what they believe are their remaining days by completing a series of exciting challenges, they discover a love that brings them a miracle—a child. Now they must face an agonizing choice: continue treatment or sacrifice themselves for the new life they have created.
response.tagline: Aidar and Dina meet at an oncology center and decide to spend what they believe are their remaining days together. A quiet, heartfelt drama about love, hope, and an impossible choice.
response.title: Соңғы Махаббат
